title: Derived scalar extension of a constant algebraic model with coefficient transport
statement: Let X be a scheme, B,C,D commutative rings in universe t, q:B -> C a ring homomorphism, and rho:C ~= D a ring equivalence. For a B-complex P, let L:D(B) -> D(C) with counit epsilon be any total left derived extension along q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-module-base-change]. Let K be the canonical complex representative of L(Q(P)), transported to D by restriction along rho inverse. Use the actual universe-lifted constant complexes finiteModelConstantComplex [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data] and scalar extension along adicConstantMap(rho composed with q) [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Assume that the two koszul constant functors preserve zero morphisms, so these complexes are defined. Then sheaf derived scalar extension of Q(finiteModelConstantComplex(X,B,P)) is isomorphic to Q(finiteModelConstantComplex(X,D,K)). There is no adic ideal, completed object, chart, or input local isomorphism.

source.place: lemma-derived-base-change (06YY), lemma-pullback-K-flat (0G7E), and lemma-derived-pullback-composition (0D6D); sites-modules.tex lemma-constant-exact (093J) for constant realization

proof.text: Choose a filtered-free K-projective resolution in the original coefficient universe. Lifting its rings along ULift ring equivalences and its module carriers by ModuleCat.uliftFunctor preserves the filtration and free generators. It is therefore still a K-flat resolution in the larger universe. The maps up(c tensor x) -> up(c) tensor up(x) and their inverse are balanced and commute with differentials, so ordinary scalar extension commutes with this lift.

Apply the existing constant-realization scalar-extension comparison to the lifted ring map. The koszul constant functor is the same constant module presheaf followed by module sheafification, with the ring universe lift. This gives an isomorphism between sheaf derived scalar extension of the constant model and constant realization of the lifted algebraic scalar extension.

The universal property of L with epsilon identifies its result on the original K-projective resolution with the algebraic scalar-extension computation. Restriction along rho inverse is an exact ring-equivalence transport and is left adjoint to restriction along rho. Thus uniqueness of adjoints identifies it with extension along rho; derived composition identifies the ring map rho composed with q. Exact coefficient transport and exact realization carry the canonical isomorphism Q(objPreimage(L(Q(P)))) -> L(Q(P)) to the final representative comparison.

theorem finiteModel_derivedScalarComparison
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {B C D : Type t} [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (q : B →+* C) (ρ : C ≃+* D)
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X D).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ)
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} C))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ModuleCat.extendScalars q)
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj q).left_adjoint_additive
        (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))) :
    let K := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t} ρ.symm.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.objPreimage (L.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
    Nonempty
      ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (adicConstantMap X (ρ.toRingHom.comp q))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X D K))
